own.notes: Amounts are GBP pence. For integer quantity q in 1..1000, select the last segment with from <= q, evaluate constant + linear*q + quadratic*q*q, and round to a nonnegative integer. The inferred ranges are 1..244, 245..449, and 450..1000. Both transitions were checked with adjacent exact quotes: quantities 244/245 returned 101639/101762 pence, and 449/450 returned 171734/144545 pence. The discounted line is consistent with 84% of the preceding linear formula. Validation: this predictor exactly matches all 96 distinct own-context observations, including 67 additional quantities queried after fixing the predictor. Those 67 validation checks had zero exact-match failures, zero errors exceeding 1%, and zero errors exceeding 5%. Discounted-region checks covered all 25 fractional-pence residue classes implied by the slope. Confidence is high in this three-region reconstruction, but the remaining 904 quantities were not observed; unseen accuracy and the absence of narrow exceptions are not proven.

other.notes: Independently reconstructed from successful other-context REA quotes, not copied from own. Amounts are GBP pence; select the last segment with from <= q, evaluate its polynomial, and round to a nonnegative integer. The inferred ranges are 1..50, 51..306, and 307..1000. Adjacent exact quotes confirmed both transitions: quantities 50/51 returned 62377/62610 pence, and 306/307 returned 251820/204575 pence. The discounted line is consistent with 81% of the preceding linear formula. Its supplied constant includes a 0.000001-pence numerical guard above 20062.08 to prevent floating-point evaluation from rounding half-pence cases downward; this is a predictor implementation safeguard, not an observed additional charge. Validation: all 96 distinct other-context observations match exactly, including 67 additional quantities queried after fixing the predictor. Those validation checks had zero exact-match failures and zero errors exceeding 1% or 5%. Checks covered all 50 discounted fractional-pence residue classes and every implied half-pence case in the discounted range. Confidence is high, but the remaining 904 quantities are predictions, not observations; narrow unseen exceptions cannot be excluded.
